cleared.title: No dedup guard: same violation set triggers email every hour
cleared.recommendation: Add a persistent 'last_sent' timestamp or 'acknowledged' flag to the state, or compare against a stored set of previously sent signatures to prevent email floods.

cleared.title: Recovery alert floods: state signature never cleared after recovery
cleared.recommendation: Clear the state signature (e.g., set to None or empty string) after sending the recovery notice, so the condition will not re-trigger on the next check cycle.

findings.title: State directory may not exist
findings.evidence: The code attempts to write to `/var/lib/app/health_alert_state.json` without first ensuring the directory exists. If the directory is missing, `os.replace` will raise an OSError and the state file will never be updated.
findings.recommendation: Add `os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(STATE_PATH), exist_ok=True)` before the file write, or wrap the write in a try/except that handles the missing directory case.
